usedFor: WhatsApp holds incoming messages and Google Calendar holds events, so “New Message Received” can add one through “Create Calendar Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Message Received” in WhatsApp, then “Create Calendar Event” in Google Calendar
bestTemplate.why: A message about a meeting can become an event with time, duration and attendees.

watchOut: “New Message Received” fires for every message unless narrowed to chosen contacts, so filter before “Create Calendar Event”.
